messages:
jordan: FYI planning a cross-stack power redistribution in az3 between 02:00-04:00 UTC Tuesday. We'll do staggered node drains + soft reboots to move thermal load off rack lanes. Expect 10-15% capacity reduction in az3-hosted GPU pools during the window. pinging @ops-oncall and @eng-sre
sam: Sounds good — what pools specifically? Can we limit to `pool-gpu-highmem` and `pool-gpu-spot` first? :thumbsup:
maria: Please add a backfill plan and make sure our dedicated tenants in az3 have failover to eu fallback region. Need to approve SLA impact doc.
ops-oncall: Oncall here — window ok but we need a runbook. Also what's the expected preflight warm cache time? last time we saw cold starts spike latency.
nick: Backfill: we'll spin up 4 x a2s-micro equivalents in eu for the canary tenants; cost uplift ~ $120/hr for the 2hr peak. Also recommend enabling `prefix_cache` warmup with `--warmup=300` prior to drain.
jordan: Runbook gist:
```
# drain order: lane-3 -> lane-1 -> lane-4 -> lane-2
for rack in lane-3 lane-1 lane-4 lane-2:
  api drain --rack $rack --grace 300
  wait for tasks 0/active
  reboot rack
  verify svc-health --region az3
```
Also we'll set routing policy to prefer eu fallback and enable model-variant fallback for heavy seqs.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ticket INFRA-4217, ETA 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z -> 2026-05-12T04:00:00Z. Notifying affected owners.
sam: I'll put a short blurb in status page and queue customer comms template.
jordan: thanks — will post final timeline + canary times. if anyone has objections, flag before 24h out. :wave:
